# Jingyue Glass (Wuhan Jingyueda Household Products Co., Ltd.)

> Direct Factory Glassware Manufacturer & Exporter (B2B / OEM / ODM / Private Label)
> Official Website: https://www.jingyueglass.com/
> Inquiries & Quotations: sales@jingyueglass.com | https://www.jingyueglass.com/custom-glassware-quote-checklist
> Direct Contact: WhatsApp: +86 132 5662 7201 | WeChat: 132 5662 7201

## Core Business Summary
Jingyue Glass manufactures lead-free crystal wine glasses, machine-blown stemware, heavy-base beer steins, crystal whiskey decanters, high-borosilicate mugs, and turnkey wooden gift box sets with odorless EPE pearl cotton inserts. Sourcing channels include commercial hospitality venues, winery tasting rooms, Amazon FBA private label sellers, and corporate gifting distributors.

## Quotation, Sampling & Commercial Policy
- **Flexible MOQ & Fast Sampling:** Standard production MOQ starts from 500–1,000 pcs; low-MOQ laser engraving pre-production sampling available from 48 pcs within 3–5 working days.
- **Advanced Decoration:** 580°C kiln-fired ceramic decal (scratch-resistant & commercial dishwasher safe), high-precision laser engraving, frosted acid etching, and real gold rim application.
- **Custom Mold Refund:** 100% tooling & private mold fee refundable upon reaching agreed cumulative order volume.
- **Project Quotation:** All customized OEM/ODM glassware orders are quoted on a project basis according to quantity, glass composition, decoration technique, packaging specification, and destination trade terms (FOB/CIF/DDP).
- Itemized quotations are provided within 1 business hour upon RFQ submission.
